Class WrappedQueue.Priority<A,B>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.types.util.WrappedObject<A,B>
com.saicone.types.util.WrappedCollection<A,B>
com.saicone.types.util.WrappedQueue<A,B>
com.saicone.types.util.WrappedQueue.Priority<A,B>
Type Parameters:
A - the base type of object.
B - the type of object to represent A.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<B>, Collection<B>, Queue<B>
Enclosing class:
WrappedQueue<A,B>
public static class WrappedQueue.Priority<A,B> extends WrappedQueue<A,B>
Represents a PriorityQueue of type A as a PriorityQueue of type B.
Unlike other wrapped objects, this one should be declared as a Queue.
